headline: Batman #1: The Iconic Cover Missed Two Major Debuts
post:
According to ComicBook.com, the legendary 1940 release of Batman #1 left out two massive characters on its cover art despite marking the very first appearances of both the Joker and Catwoman. Even with this oversight, a low-grade copy recently pulled in a massive $140k at auction through Heritage.

Alongside those historic villain debuts, the milestone issue also featured an early Hugo Strange story where the Caped Crusader famously took a life before DC codified his strict no-killing rule a few issues later. Spanning eighty-six years of continuous publishing, the historic series remains an absolute cornerstone of DC history.

What’s your favorite key issue of Batman? 🦇📚 #Batman #DCComics #ComicBooks
original_title: Batman #1 Is One of the Most Iconic Comic Books Ever Published, But Its Cover Left Out Two Legendary Debuts

headline: Marvel and DC: Eight successor heroes who outshone their origins
post:
Passing the torch is never easy, but some comic book successors truly redefined their legendary roles. According to Screen Rant, across DC and Marvel Comics, several replacement heroes completely outgrew their predecessors' shadows to become the definitive versions fans know today. 

From Kamala Khan proudly embracing her own identity as Ms. Marvel to Johnny Storm stepping up as the fiery heart of the Fantastic Four, these characters brought something fresh to the table. We also saw heroes like Scott Lang earn the Ant-Man suit through sheer resourcefulness, and Tim Drake brilliantly deduce Batman's secret identity to become an invaluable Robin. Meanwhile, Barbara Gordon transformed Batgirl from a supporting role into an independent crimefighter, Miles Morales expanded Spider-Man's powers with bio-electric blasts, and Wally West pushed the limits of the Speed Force as the Flash.

It is fascinating to see how these iconic mantles evolved over time. Who is your absolute favorite legacy hero in comics? 

#Marvel #DC #Superheroes
original_title: 8 Superhero Replacements Who Were Better Than The Original
